title: SpeakResponse
description: POST /speak response: the text in lang, the Polly voice and a presigned MP3 URL. voice and url are null and note says why when Polly has no voice for lang.

text.description: The text translated into lang by Amazon Translate. The request text when lang is en.

lang.description: The request lang: en, es, zh, ko, vi, tl, yue, ja, ar, pt, fr, ru, hi or te.

voice.description: The Polly standard voice ID, for example Lupe. null when Polly has no voice for lang.

url.description: Presigned MP3 URL, valid for 1 hour. null when voice is null.

note.description: For example "Polly has no Vietnamese voice" when voice is null. null otherwise.
